action.instructions: In this turn-based party RPG battle, which single action should the paladin take?

criteria.attack: Attack the weakest enemy, especially to finish it, when the party is safe.
criteria.aoe_skill: Use the area skill when several enemies are present and mana allows.
criteria.heal: Heal an ally whose health is low enough to fall this round.
criteria.guard: Guard to halve a big attack aimed at the paladin this round.
criteria.use_item: Use a phoenix feather to revive the fallen knight.

danger.instructions: If the paladin simply attacks, how likely is a party member to fall?
criteria: Unlikely: nobody falls this round or the next.
Very likely: someone falls this round.
